records.summary: Oregon QB Dante Moore, top 2027 draft prospect, ruled out for remainder of 2026 season due to concussion.
records.source_excerpt: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore, who entered the season as one of the top prospects in the 2027 draft, will not play again during the 2026 season.

records.summary: Rookie Makai Lemon scores first NFL touchdown on 4-yard reception.
records.source_excerpt: Rookie Makai Lemon scored his first NFL touchdown, a 4-yard reception from Tanner McKee.

records.summary: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love expected to practice Wednesday after missing two games with ankle injury.
records.source_excerpt: Jeremiyah Love has missed the past two games with a sprained left ankle, but the Cardinals running back is close to returning.

records.summary: Eagles WR Makai Lemon led pass catchers with 7 of 8 targets for 67 yards and TD in loss to Cowboys.
records.source_excerpt: Lemon brought in seven of eight targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles' 38-21 loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.

records.summary: Raiders considering potential Fernando Mendoza turn amid four-game losing streak after 3-0 start.
records.source_excerpt: Las Vegas has dropped four consecutive games after a 3-0 start, potentially moving the franchise closer to Mendoza

records.summary: Mendoza won't start in Week 8 vs Jets; Raiders sticking with Kirk Cousins despite top pick speculation.
records.source_excerpt: Despite some rumblings that the Las Vegas Raiders were on the verge of giving top overall pick Fernando Mendoza his first career start in the team's Week 8 games against the New York Jets, the team has decided to stick with veteran Kirk Cousins at quarterback.

records.summary: Makai Lemon registered his first NFL touchdown on MNF with a 7-67-1 line against the Cowboys.
records.source_excerpt: Makai Lemon had the best game of his young career, posting a 7-67-1 line against the Cowboys on Monday night.

records.summary: Giants sticking with Dominic Zvada despite ugly kicking performance with multiple misses.
records.source_excerpt: Zvada also missed a 56-yarder earlier in the game, and the Giants opted not to go for a 55-yard attempt in the second half.
